answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose KGI (Knowledge Graph Induction), a robust system for slot filling based on advanced training strategies for both Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)...

answer_2.quote: The metrics we report include accuracy and F1 on the slot filler, where F1 is based on the recall and precision of the tokens in the answer... R-Precision and Recall@5... KILT-Accuracy and KILT-F1...
